details: Bitcoin pared some gains but remained above $66,000 following reports of an interim peace deal between the U.S. and Iran. This development has helped ease geopolitical tensions and contributed to a recovery in the cryptocurrency market from recent losses.
title: Bitcoin Rises Above $66K on US-Iran Interim Peace Deal

details: Martins Kazaks, a member of the European Central Bank's Governing Council, indicated that the ECB may pursue gradual policy adjustments, as risks to inflation are leaning upward. This statement, made after the ECB's June 11 rate hike, suggests the possibility of additional tightening if inflation remains elevated, which could introduce headwinds for cryptocurrency markets.
title: ECB Official Hints at Further Rate Tightening Amid Inflation Risks

details: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) has increased its interest rate by 25 basis points to 1%. This decision by the BOJ has redirected market attention away from the recent U.S.-Iran peace agreement. Bitcoin maintained its position above $65,000 following the announcement.
title: BOJ Raises Rates to 1%, Bitcoin Holds Steady Amid Shifting Focus

details: Spot HYPE Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) are nearing $900 million in volume, with initial demand indicating increasing institutional interest in these investment products. This trend suggests a positive outlook for broader adoption and capital inflow into the cryptocurrency ecosystem through regulated financial instruments.
title: Spot HYPE ETFs See Strong Demand, Signaling Institutional Interest
